svg.title: Retrace or wait: final check
svg.desc: A working Victorian final retrace check. Every route, cross-check, hazard and group condition must be positive before following only a genuinely recognised route to the last certain point. Otherwise stop, seek help and wait actively. It also warns that a vehicle is not automatically safe and warns against an improvised missing-person search.
svg.text: Retrace or wait? Final check
WARNING — SEARCH-AND-RESCUE REVIEW OUTSTANDING
Editorial estimate: stay wording 90%; safe retrace judgement 65%.
Use only after the first tree. Unknown = NO; no time or distance is safe.
No river, steep descent, fire-front escape or injured self-evacuation.
CAN YOU ESTABLISH A DEPENDABLE ROUTE
BACK TO THE LAST CERTAIN POINT?
Every applicable item must be YES:
• You genuinely recognise the same route.
• The map, signs and surroundings agree.
• Another person checks your interpretation, if available.
• No rising water, steep ground, fire or unsafe darkness.
• Conditions suit the whole group, and everyone remains together.
ANY NO / UNKNOWN
ALL YES
STOP — DO NOT RETRACE
Seek help and remain findable.
Make nearby shelter and signals.
Do not set a rescue deadline or
leave when it expires.
FOLLOW ONLY THAT ROUTE
Keep the group together.
Stop and seek help if certainty is
lost or conditions worsen.
No universal limit applies.
IF YOU WAIT: WAITING IS ACTIVE WORK
• Improve shelter and insulation without moving far.
• Protect clean water. Make your position visible.
• Listen and answer signals. Record care; keep contact ready.
A VEHICLE IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY SAFE
Flood, falling trees, heat or bushfire can make it unsafe.
Tell responders whether you are with the vehicle.
Never run an engine or combustion appliance in
an enclosed or poorly ventilated shelter.
SOMEONE ELSE IS MISSING?
Stop the remaining group spreading out. Account for everyone.
Call 000 and ask for Police. Give the last definite place and time,
clothing, age, medical needs, destination and carried equipment.
Do not start an off-track search; it may lose more people.
No universal messenger or group-splitting rule is supplied.
Follow Police when contact is available.
Do not leave an injured person on the strength of this card.
WORKING DRAFT — specialist and stressed-reader review outstanding
